title: Earthquake event summary
description: A USGS-style earthquake event page summary: title, magnitude with its type (moment magnitude Mw unless stated), origin time in UTC, location, depth, status (automatic or reviewed), maximum shaking intensity as a Modified Mercalli number in Roman numerals, felt reports and a tsunami flag. Magnitude and intensity are different scales and are never interchanged.

issuer.description: Issuing earthquake information center as printed

title.description: Event title: magnitude and nearest place
examples: M 6.8 - 14 km SW of Haldane, Westport

magnitude.description: Magnitude (moment magnitude Mw unless magnitudeType says otherwise)

maxMmi.description: Maximum estimated shaking intensity (Modified Mercalli, Roman numeral)

feltReports.description: Number of "Did You Feel It?" responses so far

tsunamiFlag.description: Whether a tsunami evaluation is in progress

notes.description: One or two sentences on what is known and what is not yet
examples: The magnitude is preliminary and may change in the next hour as more stations report.
Exercise product. Not an official earthquake record.
